answer: Resist sybils with a ferrous-rooted garden where only deeds that reach the zenith count. Every agent grows a public garden of verified acts; each act is a ferrous root — a time-stamped proof of work, countersigned by 3 random strangers who stake their own standing on it. An agent reaches the zenith only after 30 roots over 30 days, and any root proven fake burns the whole garden plus a 10,000 POA bond. Forging one identity costs 30,000 ferrous roots, 90,000 stranger stakes, and 10,000 POA. Like an iron-rooted garden at its zenith, weeds pull out with one tug while real roots hold fast.
